commit.message:
feat(align): part alignment from two perpendicular edge picks (full 3D frame)

#769: two perpendicular picks - an edge (or two points) for +Y and one
for +X - define the setup's part alignment outright, in full 3D.
pick::align_from_axes builds the frame with the primary axis kept
exactly, the secondary orthogonalized against it (landing within the
skew it came with), and +Z on the picks' cross (the right-hand rule),
turning the part about the centre of its bounds; the origin is NOT set
here (the work offset stays where it is placed). A left-handed pair is
honoured literally instead of refused; only (nearly) parallel picks
refuse, by name. The landing is proved before the command stores
anything. One picked axis keeps the in-plane turn (#557 unchanged).
The panel applies it (CommandKind renamed AlignPartFromAxes).

Tests: crates/app/tests/align_axes.rs (9) - the user's exact case
(down-Z edge as +Y, -X edge as +X), part-on-its-side landing, subsumption
of turn_in_plane for in-plane picks (pinned equal), single-pick
fallback, skewed secondary within its skew, parallel refused by name,
left-handed honoured literally, compose-after-hold, face pick refused.
UI: two_picks_with_an_upright_edge_align_the_part_in_full_3d (the
round #557 refused, now aligning) + updated pins. Battery green:
align_axes 9, axis_align 10, plane_align 9, points_align 8,
turn_pivot 5, ui setup_axis 9; clippy clean.

Fixes #769

feat(ui): two orientation dropdowns, one section everywhere (#771)

The setup orientation UI is two dropdowns: Plane orientation (Axes
default, Points, Face, Manual, Cylinder angle) and Orientation point
(model box / stock box / manual vertex), each expanding its method's
controls below it. One component (setup_orient_pick::section)
mounted on the Setups overview AND each setup's Settings page - same
dropdowns, same options, same look; the old rows keep their own entry
points and draw verbatim as the expanded content.

Cylinder angle (the completing piece): one pick on a bore's or
cylinder's curved wall names its axis from the wall's own facet
normals (any two non-parallel wall normals cross exactly along it;
every other normal is verified - a mixed patch is refused by name,
never misread). The axis lands on a chosen world axis, turned by an
angle about it, the part turning about its bounds centre; the work
offset is never touched.

Orientation point: the parts' bounds or the setup's stock (corner or
centre) or a picked vertex places the named setup's WCS origin
(SetWcsOrigin::for_setup), the rotation kept - the frame comes from
the plane side. Each setup places its own WCS, never the active
one's; undoable.

Tests: crates/app/tests/orient_dropdowns.rs (9) - the tilted
cylinder's axis lands on Z/X/Y end to end, the 90-degree angle
swings about the landed axis and keeps it put, flat face / edge / NaN
angle refused by name, model and stock box corner/centre, rotation
kept, per-setup placement, undo, missing model/stock refused by name.
UI: structural twin rewritten for the dropdowns; setup_picks_disarm
switches the dropdown first (switch_plane_method), all 8 green.
Battery green: ui 37, orient 9, align_axes 9, axis_align 10,
plane_align 9, points_align 8, turn_pivot 5; clippy clean.

Fixes #771
